title: Fast and parallel tests and builds
summary: One runner, tests/run.py, runs every suite at the same time, splits the heavy suites across worker processes by discovery, builds the APK and the firmware alongside with toolchains shared across checkouts through ODRIG_TOOLS, reports the slowest tests, sweeps stray processes, and narrows the walkthrough; the full pass drops from about 45 to 12 minutes or less.
